Moebius IBM CP437 bitmap font

SFX includes the unmodified 4096-byte app/fonts/ibm/CP437.F16 from Moebius
1.0.29, commit 5df8344ecfad24863386d86fd5a5f494616036f8, as
moebius-cp437.f16 in the Windows Control Panel.
SHA256: ff3640ffffdd774ec56ee7ecacf7bce8324a67071155ade07f4c6380fa879025

Upstream project: https://github.com/blocktronics/moebius
Exact upstream font:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blocktronics/moebius/5df8344ecfad24863386d86fd5a5f494616036f8/app/fonts/ibm/CP437.F16

The upstream release identifies Copyright 2020 Andy Herbert and publishes
the project under the Apache License, Version 2.0. SFX preserves that
published licensing basis and the upstream font bytes. No font modification
or new authorship is claimed.
